task: 抓住桌面前景的灰色杯子，然后把它抬离桌面。

target.description: The gray textured cup with a handle sitting on a saucer in the foreground (bottom-center), distinct from the background objects.

grasp_strategy: Approach the cup from above and slightly in front, position the open gripper over the cup rim/body, close the fingers to grasp the cup, then lift vertically so the cup clears the table and saucer.
assumptions: Depth is not observable; the upward world lift is projected as a decrease in image y with a small perspective shift.
The gripper approaches from above the cup and closes around the cup body/rim.
The foreground gray cup on the saucer is the target, not the small object behind it or the background.
Motion is assumed collision-free in the unobserved 3D space.
